_note: Every dataset the Greek Study Desk is built from, pinned to an exact commit. fetch.py downloads exactly these paths at exactly these commits. The pins are the ones Threads uses (mossipo/threads build/sources.json). bible/greek/index.json carries the credit lines the page shows.

sources.name: MACULA Greek Linguistic Datasets, SBLGNT edition (Clear Bible, Biblica)
sources.attribution: MACULA Greek Linguistic Datasets, available at https://github.com/Clear-Bible/macula-greek/
sources.changes: Reformatted into compact per-book JSON. Lemmas, grammar codes, roles, trees, head words and referent links are carried over unchanged. The UBS semantic domain fields (domain, ln) are deliberately left out. Word glosses are the Berean Interlinear glosses MACULA carries (public domain); where one is missing, the Cherith gloss by Andi Wu (Cherith Analytics, CC BY 4.0) is used.
sources.used_for: Syntax trees, sentence roles, lemmas, grammar codes, word glosses, referent links; Romans 16:25-27 from its Nestle 1904 edition (not in the SBLGNT)

sources.name: SBL Greek New Testament
sources.attribution: SBLGNT, copyright 2010 by the Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software, licensed CC BY 4.0.
sources.changes: Split into words. Punctuation is kept as printed. The text-critical marks that point to the apparatus are left out.
sources.used_for: The Greek text and its punctuation

sources.name: STEPBible-Data (TAGNT, TEGMC)
sources.attribution: Data created by Tyndale House Cambridge and STEPBible.org. Source: https://STEPBible.github.io/STEPBible-Data/
sources.changes: Matched word by word to the SBLGNT. Transliterations, Strong's numbers and grammar codes are carried over unchanged. The plain-English wording for each grammar code is TEGMC's, with its low commas shown as ordinary commas.
sources.used_for: Transliteration, Strong's numbers, a second parsing to compare with MACULA's, plain-English wording for grammar codes

sources.name: Abbott-Smith, A Manual Greek Lexicon of the New Testament (1922)
sources.attribution: G. Abbott-Smith (1922). TEI edition by the translatable-exegetical-tools project.
sources.changes: Entries converted to simple HTML and keyed by Strong's number. Em dashes are shown as spaced hyphens.

sources.name: Thayer's Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (1889)
sources.attribution: J. H. Thayer (1889), keyed to Strong's numbers. Digital edition: Every-Promise-Thayers.
sources.changes: Entries keyed by Strong's number. Em dashes are shown as spaced hyphens.

in_app.name: Berean Standard Bible with its interlinear alignment
in_app.attribution: The Holy Bible, Berean Standard Bible, BSB. Public domain.
in_app.used_for: English text beside the Greek, and how the BSB rendered each Greek word (already in bible/bsb and bible/words)
